questions.subject: MTH
questions.stem_html: Given that Cos A = \(\frac{12}{13}\) for 0 ≤ A ≤ 90º, find Tan A.
questions.explanation_html:
Draw a right-angled triangle: adjacent 12, hypotenuse 13, so the opposite side is \(\sqrt{13^2-12^2}=5\). Tan A = opposite ÷ adjacent = \(\frac{5}{12}\).

Why the other options are wrong:
B: That is cos A itself, not tan A.
C: That is sin A (opposite ÷ hypotenuse).
D: That is adjacent ÷ opposite flipped wrongly: it is 1/tan A's reciprocal of the wrong pair.

questions.subject: PHY
questions.stem_html: Two resistors of 4 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in series. What is their total resistance?
questions.explanation_html:
In series the same current flows through each resistor, so resistances add: R = 4 + 6 = 10 Ω.

Why the other options are wrong:
A: You subtracted. Series resistances never cancel.
C: You multiplied. No resistor rule multiplies resistances alone.
D: That is the parallel value, 4×6 ÷ (4+6).
